title: Consultant – Business Intelligence & Data Analytics
description:
COMPANY SUMMARY


Sapling Financial Consultants is a management consulting firm, founded in 2015. What started as an idea from a kitchen table has turned into a trusted management consulting firm serving clients across North America. Headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, with a newly opened satellite office in Atlanta, Georgia, Sapling is supported by a team of 30 professionals, delivering high-quality financial modelling, due diligence, interim FP&A and data analytics solutions tailored to mid-market companies, private equity firms, investment banks, search funds and independent sponsors, infrastructure and electricity developers, as well as entrepreneurs. During the past decade, Sapling has developed a reputation for excellence in financial modelling and data analytics.

More than half of Sapling’s clients are based in the U.S., reflecting its expanding geographic footprint and growing reputation in management consulting. The firm continues to scale its capabilities, invest in new talent and maintain flexibility in response to shifting market conditions. During periods of economic uncertainty, Sapling has consistently demonstrated steady growth. The firm was recognized for its excellence, being awarded the CanadianSME National Business Award for Best Professional Service in 2023, ranked in Globe and Mail' and Ragan’s 2025 Workplace Wellness Award in the category of Learning & Development – Wellness Initiatives, as well as being ranked in Canada’s Top Growing Companies by The Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine in 2024, with a three-year growth rate of 215 per cent.


POSITION SUMMARY, DUTIES AND QUALIFICATIONS


Position Summary

We are looking for an ambitious Consultant with experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, and Statistical Analytics, who, above all, wants to do high quality, impactful work they can take pride in - work that creates real value for our clients.

Our guiding principle is We Live for A+. If you are someone who strives for excellence, not because you have to, but because you take pride in doing great work and enjoy seeing how far you can go, then Sapling might be exactly where you belong.

As a Consultant, you will collaborate with our co-founders and senior consultants to conduct in-depth analyses for management using financial and business data as well as build comprehensive management reporting for clients.

We are a boutique consultancy that differentiates itself from the big firms with best-in-class work, and we have no interest in diluting our brand. The ideal candidate can not only keep up but also win our respect through their work ethic, attention to detail, and high quality of work.

We’re looking, above all, for someone with a long-term outlook who wants to join like-minded people in building a wildly successful company founded on the principle of creating high-impact value for clients.

This role will help you deepen and widen your data analytics and modelling skills and provide you with hands-on experience with client and business development. Ultimately, you will play a large role in a small but growing team with big ambitions for the future.

Our company is on a hybrid model, with the entire team in-office Tuesdays and Wednesdays (2 days/week at 100 Sheppard Avenue East, Suite 870, Toronto), and the balance of days at home. Our hybrid model is a reflection of the independence that our team is entrusted with in completing their work.


Responsibilities

      • Data extraction from various systems including accounting systems, operational systems, HR systems, web databases etc. using data extraction tools, custom coding, API connectors, and other extraction techniques
      • Mine, analyze, and model large datasets to help define the structure of the database. Develop custom data warehouses and algorithms to apply to data sets
      • Comprehensive data manipulations and transformations using SQL to clean the data of any discrepancies and re-organize data sets in desirable forms
      • Use predictive modeling to assist in estimating revenue generation and other business outcomes
      • Preparing outputs for clients including business reporting packages, financial dashboards, and operational performance trackers using data visualization tools
      • Coordinate with different client teams to implement models. Develop processes and tools to monitor and analyze system performance and data accuracy
      • Develop financial analyses / data analyses providing actionable insight to management through spreadsheets
      • Oversee and conduct quality control on the work of the Analysts on the team
      • Manage client relationships, ensuring overall satisfaction and looking for pertinent opportunities to provide additional services to existing clients
      • As required, and depending on available billable work, assist with proposals (“live” client leads, government bids, etc.), marketing material development, writing of white papers and blogs, and help in the process of disseminating marketing materials (emails, webinars, etc.)

      Skills & Qualifications

      • A Bachelor or Master’s degree in a relevant discipline (i.e., computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, science ) is required, though work experience in a relevant field coupled with a non-related Bachelor’s degree (humanities, social sciences, etc.) can substitute
      • Experience using programming languages (C#, R, Python, or other languages,) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets
      • Deep understanding of relational databases and hands-on experience with MySQL and/or SQL
      • Experience or certification using Microsoft Azure services is welcomed, but not a must
      • Hands-on experience with Excel Lookup functions, Pivots, VBA Macros
      • Experience with data analysis and machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.)
      • Experience in data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a strong differentiator
      • 2-4 years experience in analytical role with involvement in screening / manipulating / analyzing big data sets and/or building/maintaining KPI dashboards
      • Intellectual curiosity and passion for learning about new industries and new businesses
      • Ability to take ownership of responsibilities and see them through to completion
      • Ability to work independently and manage time and multiple tasks / deadlines / deliverables at once
      • Strong dedication to the team and excellent work ethic, as well as enthusiasm about going above and beyond to ensure our clients achieve their business goals
      • Experience with coaching junior staff and providing feedback is considered an asset
      • Desire to contribute to the firm over the long haul, with the understanding that loyalty and hard work will be recognized in both compensation and responsibilities far more quickly than in a large “brand-name” firm


      APPLICATION DETAILS

      • Start Date: We are looking for 1 full-time team member to start with us as early as January 2027.
      • Location: Toronto
      • Salary Range: $90,000 to $130,000 plus bonus
      • Application Materials:
      1. Resume
      2. Cover Letter
      3. Answering a couple of questions on our online form

      We do not use AI to review your application. When it is reviewed, it is reviewed by a human being, likely a senior one, at Sapling. This reflects the care with which we do all our work. At Sapling, you are a person in whose growth we are deeply vested - you are not a number, and not data for a large language model.

Title : Sr Security EngineeLocation : Hyderabad, India

The Sr Security Engineer will, under general direction perform all procedures necessary to ensure the safety of information systems assets and to protect systems from intentional or inadvertent access or destruction. Interfaces with user community to understand their security needs and implements procedures to accommodate them. Ensures that user community understands and adheres to necessary procedures to maintain security. May require familiarity with domain structures, user authentication, and digital signatures. Conducts accurate evaluation of the level of security required. May require understanding of firewall theory and configuration. Must be able to weigh business needs against security concerns and articulate issues to management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own platform management lifecycle for a portfolio of security platforms (e.g., EDR/XDR, SIEM/SOAR, CSPM/CWPP, NGFW/SASE, PAM/IAM, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and more) — including health monitoring, patching, upgrades, scaling, backup/recovery, and decommissioning

  • Perform daily/weekly operational hygiene: configuration tuning, alert rule optimization, log source validation, false-positive reduction, capacity planning, and performance troubleshooting across heterogeneous environments (on-prem, multi-cloud, SaaS)

  • Implement secure IAM integrations and controls across platforms including SSO federation (SAML/OIDC), MFA enforcement, RBAC/ABAC policies, just-in-time/elevated access, SCIM provisioning, and identity governance workflows

  • Troubleshoot and resolve platform-level incidents (e.g., authentication failures, data ingestion issues, API outages, privilege escalation paths)

  • Monitor emerging trends in platform consolidation, and IAM (e.g., password less, decentralized identity) recommend rationalization or enhancements to reduce tool sprawl while maintaining coverage

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation: architecture diagrams, runbooks, integration maps, IAM policy standards, and operational procedures for the platform ecosystem

  • Support incident response when platform or IAM-related issues impact detection/response capabilities

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, or platform administration roles

  • Proven experience managing and supporting multiple enterprise security platforms in production with deep operational ownership (not just deployment)

  • Strong generalist foundation across security domains: endpoint (EDR/XDR), network (NGFW/SASE), cloud security (CSPM/CWPP), SIEM/SOAR, vulnerability management, and identity

title: Project Coordinator (Interim Infrastructure)
description:
PACT (Pearson Accelerator Construction Team) is a General Partnership of Alberici, Amico, Kenaidan, and Obayashi, supported by design partners Egis, Mott MacDonald, and Weston Williamson + Partners. Together, we are delivering Accelerator, a major program of Pearson LIFT (Long-term Investment in Facilities and Terminals), Toronto Pearson's infrastructure development plan. This multi-year program is designed to address immediate passenger growth demands while preparing Canada’s largest airport for the future of air travel—including critical upgrades to airfield and infrastructure, greenhouse gas reduction initiatives, modernization of Terminals 1 and 3, and the creation of a world-class passenger experience.

JOB SUMMARY

The Project Coordinator will support the planning, execution, and monitoring of work within the Interim Infrastructure Sub-Program at Toronto Pearson Airport. This includes a mix of airside and terminal-adjacent works, such as aircraft hardstands, roadway infrastructure (including North Service Road), and enabling and expansion works within Terminals 1 & 3.


This role will support delivery in a complex, live airport environment where construction activities must be carefully coordinated with ongoing operations. Responsibilities include project administration, construction documentation, site coordination, schedule and cost tracking, and ensuring alignment with PACT delivery strategies and program reporting requirements.


The Project Coordinator plays a key role in supporting fast-paced, phased delivery, where design and construction may progress in parallel and early works packages are advanced to protect schedule and minimize operational disruption.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support Project Manager(s) in planning and executing construction activities across airside, roadway, and terminal interface projects.
  • Coordinate enabling works, phased construction activities, and early works packages to support accelerated delivery.
  • Prepare and maintain project schedules, lookaheads, and progress trackers aligned with program milestones.
  • Coordinate site access, permits (including airside and restricted area access), inspections, and contractor onboarding.
  • Assist in organizing design reviews, constructability workshops, and stakeholder coordination meetings.
  • Maintain common data environment (ACC) for RFIs, change orders, submittals, drawings, and site instructions in accordance with program controls requirements.
  • Support review and routing of contractor and consultant submissions for completeness and compliance.
  • Track construction progress, deficiencies, commissioning activities, and close-out documentation across multiple concurrent work areas.
  • Support procurement activities, including preparation of scopes of work and coordination of early release packages.
  • Prepare monthly progress reports, dashboards, and key performance indicators for internal and client reporting.
  • Liaise with contractors, consultants, engineering teams, airport operations, and internal stakeholders to coordinate work in active environments.
  • Attend site visits; document site observations, constraints, and action items, particularly within active airside and terminal areas.
  • Coordinate construction activities to minimize disruption to airport operations, including staging, access, and logistics planning.
  • Support compliance with safety, security, and regulatory requirements specific to airport construction environments.
  • Ensure project documentation meets PACT, GTAA, and regulatory reporting standards.
  • Participate in risk identification, constructability reviews, and quality/commissioning activities.
  • Support with other duties as needed.

WORKING CONDITIONS

The position will be based at our office in Mississauga, Ontario, with visits to the Airport site as required. Your work schedule will be Monday to Friday during regular office or site hours. At times, operational needs may require work outside these hours, with reasonable notice provided. All schedule or on call adjustments will comply with applicable employment standards legislation. It is mandatory for all employees to complete a Criminal Background check and successfully attain a Restricted Access Identity Card (RAIC) upon joining the company.

DESIRED SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, COMPETENCIES

  • Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Civil Engineering Technology, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  • 1–3 years of experience in project coordination within a construction environment.
  • Strong interest in supporting large infrastructure projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with GTAA or other major airport procedures is considered an asset.
  • Valid driver’s license and eligibility for RAIC clearance required.

PACT is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment accommodation in accordance with the Ontario Human Rights Code and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. We are committed to providing an inclusive and barrier free candidate experience and work environment. If you require accommodation to apply or if selected to participate in an assessment process, please advise Human Resources.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Platform Engineer

Department: Engineering

Location: Mexico

Employment Type: FullTime

About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

We're looking for an amazing Senior Platform Engineer who will build the tooling, golden paths, and self-service abstractions that let our product teams move fast - not just operate clusters, but engineer the infrastructure layer itself.

About the Role

This is a platform engineer, not a traditional SRE. We want a strong software engineer who specializes in infrastructure - someone who builds tooling, golden paths, and self-service abstractions for product teams, not just someone who operates clusters. Hard software engineering skills are the bar; infra and SRE depth is how that bar gets applied.

This role will include:

  • IaC repos: typed component resources, factories, multi-env stacks (Pulumi, Terraform)

  • The EKS platform: Karpenter autoscaling, and GitOps delivery via ArgoCD, Kargo, and Helm

  • CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and release automation

  • Developer-experience tooling and AI-driven development workflows (skills, hooks, MCP servers, managed agents)

  • Observability, network and edge security, and SOC 1 + SOC 2 evidence automations

Our Stack

  • AWS + EKS

  • Pulumi (TypeScript) + Terraform

  • Kubernetes

  • ArgoCD + Kargo + Helm GitOps

  • Aurora PostgreSQL + Prisma + Slonik

  • DynamoDB

  • EventBridge + SQS

  • OpenTelemetry + Datadog

A strong, infrastructure-minded software engineer will thrive in this role! If you're excited about building developer platforms, AI-driven workflows, and rock-solid cloud infrastructure, apply with us!

What you’ve accomplished:

  • Strong AWS services knowledge

  • Strong in JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node

  • Solid grasp of parallel programming

  • Deep PostgreSQL and ORM optimization skills (Prisma, Slonik, etc.)

  • Hands-on with NoSQL databases (Redis, DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, etc.)

  • Experience with message brokers

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, any tool works (Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK, or similar)

  • Experience building RESTful APIs

  • Production Kubernetes experience, ideally EKS (Karpenter, VPC CNI with NetworkPolicy, managed node groups, multi-cluster)

  • Familiarity with observability standards and tooling, vendor-agnostic (OpenTelemetry, any APM platform)

  • Network segmentation know-how (VPCs, subnetting, security groups, firewall config, DNS, etc.)

  • Edge and network security (CloudFront, WAF, ACM certificates, on top of VPC segmentation)

  • Pipeline configuration, ideally GitHub Actions

  • Strong in AI-driven development (Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar) and fluent in its building blocks: skills, hooks, custom commands, managed agents, etc.

Nice to have:

  • GraphQL or gRPC

  • GitOps with ArgoCD, Kargo, and Helm

  • Certifications (AWS, CNCF, Linux Foundation, etc.)

  • Security tooling (SAST, Software Composition Analysis, IAST, SIEM, threat management) and compliance frameworks like SOC 1 and SOC 2

  • SRE and reliability practices (SLOs, error budgets, incident response, runbooks, on-call)

  • FinOps and cost management (cost allocation on EKS, right-sizing, Savings Plans)

  • Compliance automation (SOC 2 evidence, IAM Identity Center and permission sets, least-privilege access)

What you care about:

  • Customer Obsession: You care deeply about our customers and go the extra mile to delight them

  • Intentional Communication: You have a bias towards written communication and documentation to open up access to your thinking, and you listen with openness and curiosity.

  • Growth: You are excited by problems because they’re opportunities for improvement.

  • Participate in cross-functional improvement initiatives, internal audits, and quality investigations to identify and implement process enhancements.

What You Need

Preferred

title: AI Safety Experts — English & Odia
description:
Location: Remote

Fluent Language Skills Required: English & Odia. Native fluency in English and Odia is required for this position.

Why This Role Exists

At Mercor, we believe the safest AI is the one that’s already been attacked — by us. We are assembling a red team for this project - human data experts who probe AI models with adversarial inputs, surface vulnerabilities, and generate the red team data that makes AI safer for our customers.

This project involves reviewing AI outputs that touch on sensitive topics such as bias, misinformation, or harmful behaviors. All work is text-based, and participation in higher-sensitivity projects is optional and supported by clear guidelines and wellness resources. Before being exposed to any content, the topics will be clearly communicated.

What You’ll Do

  • Red team conversational AI models and agents: jailbreaks, prompt injections, misuse cases, bias exploitation, multi-turn manipulation

  • Generate high-quality human data: annotate failures, classify vulnerabilities, and flag systemic risks

  • Apply structure: follow taxonomies, benchmarks, and playbooks to keep testing consistent

  • Document reproducibly: produce reports, datasets, and attack cases customers can act on

Who You Are

  • You bring prior red teaming experience (AI adversarial work, cybersecurity, socio-technical probing)

  • You’re curious and adversarial: you instinctively push systems to breaking points

  • You’re structured: you use frameworks or benchmarks, not just random hacks

  • You’re communicative: you explain risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • You’re adaptable: thrive on moving across projects and customers

Nice-to-Have Specialties

  • Adversarial ML: jailbreak datasets, prompt injection, RLHF/DPO attacks, model extraction

  • Cybersecurity: penetration testing, exploit development, reverse engineering

  • Socio-technical risk: harassment/disinfo probing, abuse analysis, conversational AI testing

  • Creative probing: psychology, acting, writing for unconventional adversarial thinking

What Success Looks Like

  • You uncover vulnerabilities automated tests miss

  • You deliver reproducible artifacts that strengthen customer AI systems

  • Evaluation coverage expands: more scenarios tested, fewer surprises in production

  • Mercor customers trust the safety of their AI because you’ve already probed it like an adversary

Why Join Mercor

  • Build experience in human data-driven AI red teaming at the frontier of safety

  • Play a direct role in making AI systems more robust, safe, and trustworthy

title: Director, Strategic Accounts – North East

Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Director, Strategic Accounts – North East

Labcorp is seeking a field-based Director, Strategic Accounts to join our Specialty Oncology team supporting the North East territory. The ideal person will be located within CT, NY, MA, NH, NJ or PA.

National Oncology Opportunity Development

• Identify, originate, and advance top-down enterprise oncology opportunities across assigned accounts.

Health System & IDN Enterprise Leadership

Divisional Alignment & Execution

• 7 years of demonstrated success in enterprise or national-level sales and business development.

Preferred Qualifications

• 7 years of sales experience within oncology diagnostics, precision medicine, or molecular testing.

Additional Job Standards

• Familiarity with value-based care models and enterprise healthcare strategy.

• Strong understanding of health system dynamics, IDNs, and oncology service lines.

• Proven ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders

• Experience leading complex, multi-site, and multi-stakeholder initiatives.

• Experience working across cross-functional commercial and operational teams.

• Enterprise Leadership - align strategy with organizational objectives and drive large-scale transformation initiatives.

• Strategic Selling & Innovation: Identify and unlock new enterprise opportunities through innovative, solution-based selling.

• Collaboration & Influence: effectively partner across national, regional, and functional teams while influencing without direct authority.

• Ability to travel as required for national account coverage (up to 30%) and have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record

The National Strategic Director will act as a strategic partner and decision point to develop and drive strategy and tactics to strengthen and grow an assigned group of strategic accounts, and new strategic partnership opportunities.

title: Producer
description:
Every GYG shoot needs someone who has planned every detail — the talent, the props, the call sheets, the budget, and the fifteen things that can go sideways on a shoot day. The Producer owns all of it, so the creative team can show up and focus entirely on the work. If you love the organised chaos of a shoot day and take real pride in tight production, this is your role.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end pre-production planning across all video, stills, and social shoots
  • Source, brief, and manage talent including crew, ambassadors, customers, and extras
  • Organise props, wardrobe, locations, permits, and on-set logistics for every shoot
  • Build and maintain shoot schedules, call sheets, and run sheets for every production
  • Manage external suppliers and freelancers including videographers, photographers, stylists, and crew

  • Build long-term relationships with talent agencies, suppliers, and crew to give GYG a strong production network

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years in a producer or production role within a brand, agency, or production company
  • Demonstrated track record producing shoots end to end, from brief to wrap
  • Strong budget management experience, with the ability to own and reconcile shoot budgets independently
  • Confident managing multiple shoots and timelines simultaneously without dropping detail
  • Strong network of talent, agents, freelancers, and external suppliers (or the ability to build one quickly)
  • Expert working knowledge of production paperwork including call sheets, contracts, releases, and budgets
  • Calm, structured, and resourceful under shoot-day pressure
  • Strong leadership presence on-set, comfortable directing crew and making real-time decisions
  • Food, hospitality, or QSR production experience an advantage

What You'll Love

  • Join one of Australia's fastest-growing restaurant companies
  • Real career growth in a marketing function that's investing heavily in its capability
  • Annual short-term incentive scheme
  • GYG restricted shares, earned each year through our long-term incentive scheme

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/30/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Cyber Mission Integration & Capability Planner on the Cyber Defense & Resilience team, you will be responsible for:
  • Integrating Special Access Program-enabled cyber capabilities into cyberspace warfare planning and execution in support of Space Mission and Systems Deltas
  • Translating mission needs into capability recommendations, governance actions, and operational priorities across technical and mission stakeholders
  • Conducting studies, assessments, and analysis to identify gaps, inform decisions, and improve cyber mission effectiveness
  • Developing and maintaining processes, briefing materials, and decision-support products that support organizational design, planning, and operational learning
  • Coordinating with U.S. Space Force leadership, acquisition stakeholders, mission partners, and technical teams to align cyber capabilities with mission requirements

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client's technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:
  • Bachelor's degree in network engineering, computer science, information systems, software engineering, programming, or another cyber-related field
  • 7+ years of professional technical experience in cyber defense or cybersecurity, including engineering, networking, systems integration, solutions development, cyber operations, or mission support
  • 2+ years of supervisory experience
  • Experience in at least 3 of the following areas: containerized or virtualized environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, VMware, or Amazon Web Services (AWS); network access points used for traffic collection and aggregation, including Gigamon; data storage solutions, including network file system (NFS), distributed storage, or Ceph; data analysis tools, including Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, or Splunk; Agile frameworks; Linux operating systems, including Red Hat or Kali; Windows operating systems; network infrastructure and data flows; or security applications, including Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), or Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS)
  • Active Top Secret clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information eligibility, ability to satisfy Special Access Program access requirements
  • Ability to work on-site in Colorado Springs, Colorado five days a week.
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:
  • Experience supporting space mission systems, Special Access Program integration, cyber operations, organizational design, force design, studies and analysis, lessons learned, or senior stakeholder engagement
  • Experience developing process documentation, governance recommendations, briefing materials, and decision-support products
  • Experience working with U.S. Space Force leadership, operational and acquisition communities, federally funded research and development center organizations, or contractor partners

This compensation range is specific to Colorado and takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job Title:

Student Advocacy Officer

Department:

Student Life | Student Advocacy

The Program Coordinator within the Student Advocacy Center provides comprehensive advocacy, case management, consultation, and referral services to students experiencing barriers to their success. Serving as a central point of support, the Program Coordinator works collaboratively with students to assess their needs, develop individualized action plans, connect them with appropriate campus and community resources, and help them navigate complex university systems, policies, and procedures. Through ongoing case management, this position empowers students to address challenges that may affect their academic progress and overall well-being, while promoting student persistence and success. The Program Coordinator also serves as a trusted resource for faculty, staff, and campus partners by providing consultation on student concerns, facilitating communication among stakeholders, and helping identify practical solutions to complex situations.


In addition to direct student support, the Program Coordinator collaborates with university departments to identify emerging trends and systemic barriers affecting the student experience, contributing to improvements in institutional processes, coordinated care, and campus support services. A secondary focus of the position is coordinating the university's response to student crises, including student deaths and significant personal emergencies. working with campus partners to ensure timely and compassionate support for those impacted. The Program Coordinator exercises sound judgment, discretion, and empathy while navigating complex situations and building collaborative relationships that advance student success, the mission of the Student Advocacy Center, and Student Life.


Qualifications

Required: Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience; 4 years of relevant experience; experience in advising students with diverse needs; strong written and verbal communication skills. Successful completion of a criminal background check.

Desired: Master’s degree in Higher Education, Counseling, Social Work, or related field; 4 to 8 years of relevant experience; extensive knowledge of university policies and procedures.

Subfunction: Student Advocacy

Career Level: Specialized 3

The pay range for this position is $47,700 to $62,300. The offers are based on candidate experience, internal equity, and the unit’s available budget.

MISSION

The Office of Student Life fosters students’ development, learning, well-being and sense of belonging; empowers students to achieve their academic, personal and professional goals; and prepares students to be engaged in a global society.

title: O365 Integration Specialist, Senior
description:
O365 Integration Specialist, Senior

The Opportunity:

As the senior O365 Integration Specialist you will help the customer adopt governed standardized O365 architecture. You will support digital modernization and improve how the Army automates processes, generates insights, and makes data‑driven decisions. You will design and build O365 solutions, conduct verification and validation testing, deliver updates and enhancements, and manage a ticketing system to resolve user issues efficiently and keep applications mission‑ready.

As a customer-facing senior O365 Integration Specialist, you will serve as the Directorate’s primary technical advisor for client-facing data modernization. Operating at the intersection of business analysis, data modeling, and low-code engineering, this role is responsible for migrating legacy, unstructured client workflows such as email-based trackers and disconnected spreadsheets into governed, standardized Microsoft 365 environments. You will design and build front-end entry systems including PowerApps and SharePoint that enforce data quality and then partner with Data Integration Engineers to facilitate seamless automated ingestion into the enterprise analytics platforms such as Palantir Foundry.

Through this work, you will enhance the U.S. Army's digital ecosystem by improving data quality, enabling AI‑supported insights, and delivering reliable tools that empower mission partners with the information they need to act with confidence.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

  • 8+ years of experience with systems analysis, database design, or enterprise IT advising

  • 6+ years of experience performing SharePoint Site Collection Administration (SCA) at the directorate or command level, managing granular permissions, directory synchronization, and configuring complex SharePoint Lists and Document Libraries to serve as robust relational data backends

  • Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise-grade canvas and model-driven applications in PowerApps, and configuring automated workflows in Power Automate across various M365 integrations including Outlook, SharePoint, and Teams

  • Experience with relational database concepts

  • Experience establishing and auditing data input standards, such as strictly typed columns, data validation rules, and dropdowns instead of free text, to combat data drift

  • Ability to rapid-prototype functional applications with strong User Experience (UX) considerations to improve user adoption and enforce front-end data hygiene

  • Ability to discuss with GS-14 and 15 leadership and military branch chiefs, translate complex operational problems into structured technical requirements, and document business workflows

  • Ability to design, document, and defend Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs), data schemas, and Data Dictionaries to ensure downstream integration readiness

  • TS/SCI clearance

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or technical field

Nice If You Have:

  • Experience with Agile or Scrum and Jira to manage work

  • Experience utilizing professional wireframing or mock-up tools such as Visio, Balsamiq, Figma, or Draw.io to design intuitive user interfaces prior to active configuration

  • Experience operating within DoW Service Component Command (ASCC) or major military headquarters

  • Experience formatting, structuring, and preparing SharePoint backends for automated ingestion into Palantir Foundry

  • Knowledge of military staff structures and planning cycles

  • Knowledge of enterprise ETL pipelines and data lake architectures

  • Possession of excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Power Platform functional or architect Certifications such as PL-100 Power Platform App Maker, PL-200 Power Platform Functional Consultant, or PL-400 Power Platform Developer Certification

Clearance:

title: Insomniac - Creative Project Coordinator
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE YOU?

Do you enjoy dance music? Do you excel at coordinating creative projects? Then you’re in luck! We are looking for a highly motivated self-starter who embodies both a passion for dance culture and a love of creativity. Is this you? Read on…

WHO ARE WE?

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state-of-the-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.

Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993.

THE ROLE

Insomniac is looking for a Creative Project Coordinator, reporting to the Creative Project Manager, the Creative Project Coordinator will work with the brand teams, designers, and editors to coordinate the execution and delivery of creative assets for assigned campaigns. This role manages project workflows, timelines, creative approvals, and serves as the primary creative asset liaison from campaign kickoff through show weekend.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary creative project contact for assigned brands, and be equipped to provide updates on project status, timelines, bandwidth, and creative direction in coordination with their respective brand lead.

  • Partner with brand teams to translate campaign objectives into clear, actionable creative requests while maintaining timelines and taking into account designer/editor bandwidth when recommending realistic delivery dates

  • Coordinate the day-to-day workflow of design and media projects, documenting revisions and ensuring deliverables stay on track.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including but not limited to Marketing, Talent Booking, PR, Merchandise, Production, Social, Creative, and Executive stakeholders.

  • Maintain ticket requests, timelines, creative briefs, and calls-to-action as campaigns evolve.

  • Consistently execute quality control on all submitted tickets and ensure that each request is complete, final, and updated to reflect the goals of the initiative on the brand side

  • Identify errors in timelines before submitting requests and in posted assets for review prior to circulating for approvals

  • Monitor project scope, timelines, bandwidth limitations and delivery expectations to proactively identify and resolve issues in collaboration with the respective brand lead

  • Lead project communication through standups, status updates, kickoff meetings, and stakeholder check-ins where needed

  • Route creative assets for review and approval and ensure any applicable edits are communicated and applied in a timely manner

  • Assist in developing project timelines and establishing deadlines that align with campaign schedules and designer/editor bandwidth

  • Ensure all completed requests are properly finalized and maintain organized documentation, assets, and communications for future reference.

  • May be required to attend and work company events onsite as needed by the brand

  • Train and provide support in onboarding team members, clients, vendors and partners when needed

  • All other projects and initiatives as identified

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in business marketing or management or related experience

  • 1-2 years of experience in project coordination or related field

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Must be willing to travel to work during holidays, evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines

  • Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels and drastic temperature climates while working on site at various event location

  • Must be able to work in open concept office space

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Insomniac for a visa.

Job Description
Job Description

ABOUT AMGEN

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.

As a Senior Data Engineer at Amgen, you will be responsible for

designing and building enterprise knowledge and context capabilities that enable reliable, scalable, and governed AI solutions.

The role will focus on developing the foundational services through which AI applications and agents discover, retrieve, understand, and use enterprise information. This includes structured data, documents, business terminology, reference data, metadata, semantic models, business rules, and domain-specific knowledge.

The successful candidate will work across data engineering, knowledge management, metadata, search, AI, and platform engineering teams to establish reusable knowledge services rather than building isolated solutions for individual use cases.

This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical depth, architectural thinking, and the ability to work with business and scientific stakeholders to translate domain knowledge into scalable data and AI capabilities.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, or comparable modern data platforms.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, including storage, compute, security, networking, and managed AI services.

  • Experience processing unstructured content such as PDF, Microsoft Word, presentations, web content, or scientific and technical documents.

  • Understanding of search and information-retrieval concepts, including indexing, relevance, filtering, ranking, and hybrid search.

  • Experience with vector databases, embedding models, retrieval-augmented generation, semantic search, or large language model applications.

  • Familiarity with metadata-management or data-governance platforms such as Collibra or equivalent tools.

  • Experience with reference data, controlled vocabularies, taxonomies, business glossaries, ontologies, or knowledge graphs.

  • Familiarity with agentic AI patterns, orchestration frameworks, tool integration, or Model Context Protocol(MCP).

  • Experience implementing authorization, auditability, provenance, and governance for enterprise AI solutions.

  • Experience working in a regulated industry such as biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, financial services, or life sciences.

  • Knowledge of scientific, clinical, regulatory, commercial, or enterprise data domains would be advantageous.

Basic Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s or Master's degree with 8 - 13 years of experience in Computer Science, IT or related field

  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams

  • High degree of initiative and self-motivation

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully

  • Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals

  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills

title: Defence Solution Architect
description:
Envitia is a UK-based software and services company that helps organisations unlock the full value of their data to make better, faster decisions. With over 30 years of experience, we specialise in delivering innovative software products, solutions, and consultancy services that transform complex data challenges into actionable insights.

Our mission is to empower customers across defence, government, and national security sectors to harness the power of data — from geospatial intelligence to advanced analytics and AI integration. We are proud to be a trusted partner to UK defence and government organisations, delivering technology that drives smarter, data-driven outcomes.

We’re also delighted to have been named one of The Sunday Times Top 100 Medium-Sized Companies — a recognition of our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and creating an outstanding workplace where people can thrive.

The Role


At Envitia, we help Defence organisations unlock the value of their data to enable better decision-making, faster operational outcomes and greater mission success. We're looking for a Defence Solution Architect who can bridge the gap between operational need and technical delivery, translating complex mission challenges into secure, interoperable and scalable solutions.


This is a high-impact role within our Consulting division, where you'll work closely with Defence stakeholders, mission experts, engineering teams and delivery partners to design and integrate capabilities that enable effective data discovery, transformation and exchange across complex environments. You'll be responsible for creating solution architectures that not only define systems, but demonstrate how data moves, transforms and delivers operational value.


From shaping mission-led architectures and developing data models to defining integration patterns and ensuring alignment with Defence standards, security requirements and enterprise architecture principles, you'll play a key role throughout the solution lifecycle. You'll contribute to technical assurance, capability development and the successful delivery of innovative Defence solutions from concept through to implementation.


If you're passionate about solving complex Defence challenges, enabling data-driven operations and shaping the future of interoperable military capabilities, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities


  • Design and assure end-to-end solution architectures that support experimentation, integration, and Defence data interoperability.
  • Translate operational mission threads, user requirements and experimentation objectives into scalable, secure and deliverable technical solutions.
  • Produce and maintain architectural artefacts, including solution views, data flow diagrams, interface specifications, data models, integration views and decision records.
  • Define integration approaches that enable data discovery, transformation, exchange and exploitation across heterogeneous Defence systems.
  • Work collaboratively with mission engineering, software development, data engineering, experimentation and operational analysis teams to ensure architectural coherence from concept through implementation.
  • Support the definition and assurance of Information Exchange Requirements, interface contracts, non-functional requirements and security constraints.
  • Identify technical risks, interoperability challenges, architectural trade-offs and delivery dependencies, providing clear recommendations to Defence and delivery stakeholders.
  • Support experimentation planning, execution and technical reviews, ensuring lessons learned are captured and fed into future capability development.
  • Ensure solutions align with security, information assurance, Defence standards and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Provide technical leadership in solution reviews and Technical Design Authority forums.
  • Contribute reusable architecture patterns, methods and learning from customer work into Envitia’s wider architecture capability.
  • Ensure solution and data architectures are subject to robust cost and effort estimation, covering design, development, transition, operation, maintenance and exit costs.

Experience Required

  • Experience working within Defence, national security, mission engineering, operational analysis or experimentation environments.
  • Understanding of Defence interoperability, mission data and information exchange, including how data, systems and users connect across complex multi-domain operations.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable and interoperable solution architectures that enable data discovery, integration, transformation and exchange across heterogeneous environments.
  • Ability to develop and interpret mission threads, operational workflows, information exchange requirements and data models that support operational decision-making.
  • Knowledge of solution and enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or similar.
  • Experience translating business, operational, security and technical requirements into coherent end-to-end solution designs.
  • Familiarity with modern technology ecosystems, including cloud platforms (Azure and AWS), APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, event-driven architectures and COTS integrations.
  • Experience producing architecture artefacts, integration views, data flow models and assurance documentation for complex programmes.
  • Understanding of MOD and Defence standards relating to interoperability, information sharing and secure architecture.
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience presenting solution designs to Technical Design Authorities, Design Review Boards or equivalent governance forums.


Security Clearance Requirements

Due to the nature of our work, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC security clearance.

Location

This role offers flexible and remote working, with travel to our Horsham office approximately two days per month and occasional travel to customer sites across the UK as required.

What it's like to work at Envitia

At Envitia, we believe that our greatest asset is our people. We’re committed to fostering a work environment where every employee feels valued, supported, and motivated to excel. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance both your professional and personal wellbeing, including:

  • Annual Leave: 25 days plus your birthday off, with the ability to buy or sell up to five additional days
  • Private Healthcare: Comprehensive coverage with additional options for family members
  • Training & Skills Development: Ongoing learning opportunities to help you advance your career
  • Fitness Reimbursement: Support for gym memberships or fitness-related expenses
  • Life Assurance: Extensive life insurance coverage for peace of mind
  • Pension Contribution: Competitive options to help you plan for a secure financial future
  • Perkbox Subscription: Discounts on a wide range of products and services
  • Flexible Work Arrangements: Designed to support work-life balance and personal commitments
  • Internal Reward Schemes: Recognition initiatives to celebrate your contributions and achievements
  • Community Engagement & Volunteering: Opportunities to support meaningful causes through company-sponsored programs

Inclusion at Envitia

At Envitia, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life. We believe that our strength lies in our differences, and we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered.

We encourage applications from people of all abilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, races, ethnicities, and religions. We strive to support a culture of inclusion, accessibility, and work-life balance.

If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Location: Germany Remote Status: Fully Remote (#LI-Remote)

LivePerson (NASDAQ: LPSN) is a leader in trusted enterprise conversational AI and digital transformation. The world's leading brands use our award-winning Conversational Cloud platform to connect with millions of consumers. We power nearly a billion conversational interactions every month, providing uniquely rich data analytics and safety tools to unlock the power of conversational AI for better business outcomes. Fast Company named LivePerson the #1 Most Innovative AI Company in the world.

Welcome to the Agent, Admin and Supervisor Experience team at LivePerson! We are a team of 9 engineers located across 4 countries in Israel, Germany, India and Bulgaria.

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead the evolution of our frontend architecture while contributing to our full-stack ecosystem. You will work in a fast-paced environment on projects spanning different company areas, aiming to enhance, scale, and simplify how brands engage with their customers through messaging.

We are looking for an individual who wants to do more than just manage, but also shape and innovate!

  • Lead the development and enhancement of our core UI platform, leveraging micro frontend architecture for scalability and maintainability.
  • Lead AI-driven engineering practices. Champion the adoption of AI across the engineering organization by defining best practices, evaluating emerging AI-powered development tools, and establishing workflows that improve developer productivity, code quality, and architectural decision-making.
  • Mentor teams on effectively leveraging AI while maintaining engineering excellence, security, and maintainability.
  • Write high-quality, efficient, and maintainable code, while actively participating in code reviews to improve the overall quality of our codebase.

  • Create robust, testable, and performant solutions using Vue.js, Node.js, Java, and other modern technologies.
  • Take ownership of features from initial concept and UI design to back-end implementation, testing, and deployment.
  • Drive the continuous improvement of product functionality, performance, and scalability, ensuring high availability and responsiveness.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, fostering their professional growth and helping them make impactful contributions to the team.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines, and work closely on managing Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure to enable fast, reliable deployments.

You Have: Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Object-Oriented Programming (Java, C#, etc.) and Node.js
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Extensive experience with Frontend Web technologies: Vue.js (preferred), or React.js

  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire web development lifecycle, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-deployment support.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or other public cloud providers (AWS, Azure) - Advantage
  • Demonstrated success in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using modern automation tools.
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker).
  • Expertise in writing clean, maintainable code that adheres to industry best practices.
  • Write unit and integration tests for both front-end and back-end components.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and develop efficient solutions.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies, promoting iterative development and quick adaptation to changing requirements
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior developers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • A strong sense of quality, personal responsibility, and an unwavering passion for continuous improvement in software development.
  • Willingness to participate in paid on-call duty, in alignment with our "You Build It, You Run It" philosophy (One week every second month).

Our Benefits & Perks

We are committed to supporting the complete well-being, health, financial security, family, and professional growth of our permanent employees.

💰 Financial Security & Growth

  • Additional Pension scheme: deferred pension scheme (LivePerson contributes 20%), ESPP and annual bonus depending on achievements
  • Equipment: Internet and Mobile reimbursement
  • Development: Access to internal professional development resources.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Time Away & Family Support

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO): Personal time off 33 days , vacation (28 days) and care days (5)
  • Paid Public Holidays.

Volunteering Days: Use them to make a difference in your community. Whether it's a cleanup, supporting a local initiative or holding an “Ehrenamt”, just let us know! We're here to help you create a meaningful impact.

💻 Workplace Flexibility

  • Remote-First Model: Be flexible, work flexibly and from anywhere - no defined working hours or boundaries with offices in Mannheim and Berlin
  • Monthly Connection: Join our monthly connection pizza day in the office!

Why You’ll Love Working Here

As leaders in enterprise customer conversations, we celebrate diversity, empowering our team to forge impactful conversations globally. LivePerson is a place where uniqueness is embraced, growth is constant, and everyone is empowered to create their own success. We're very proud to have earned recognition from Fast Company, Newsweek, and BuiltIn for being a top innovative, beloved, and remote-friendly workplace, and recognized by Gartner as a leader in the Conversational AI space.

Belonging at LivePerson: Equal Opportunity Employer

We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by US Federal, State, or Local law.

Accessibility Commitment

LivePerson is dedicated to the accessibility needs of our applicants and employees. We provide reasonable accommodations to job applicants with disabilities. title: Employee Experience & Communications Specialist
description:
The HR Operations & Employee Experience Specialist serves as a key member of the Human Resources team, providing operational and administrative support across multiple HR functions while helping deliver exceptional employee experience. Reporting directly to the Senior Director, Talent Management & Engagement, this role serves as the primary operational support for the HR Business Partner team and is responsible for coordinating employee lifecycle activities, HR operations, onboarding, leave administration, compliance, employee engagement, and HR programs.

In addition, this role partners closely with the Director, Internal Communications & Community Engagement to support the planning, development, and execution of internal communications that inform, engage, and connect employees across the organization. This includes creating and distributing HR and company communications, supporting employee recognition initiatives, assisting with Town Hall communications, maintaining communication channels, and helping execute company events and engagement activities.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, customer-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced environment while balancing multiple priorities. This individual serves as a trusted resource for employees, leaders, and HR Business Partners by ensuring operational excellence, delivering timely communications, and supporting initiatives that strengthen Cinch's culture and employee experience.

Primary Responsibilities

HR Operations

  • Serve as the primary operational support for the HR Business Partner team.
  • Process all In Home Services (IHS) employee terminations, ensuring timely and accurate completion of all HRIS, payroll, and compliance requirements.
  • Maintain employee personnel files and HR documentation.
  • Manage HR shared services requests and respond to employee inquiries.
  • Maintain HR metrics and reports.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and operational efficiencies.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve HR processes, increase operational efficiency, and enhance the employee and candidate experience.
  • Research, recommend, and implement new technologies and best practices that support continuous improvement within HR Operations and Internal Communications.
  • Utilize AI tools to assist in drafting communications, creating presentations, analyzing HR metrics, developing training materials, and streamlining routine administrative tasks.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Leave Administration & Compliance

  • Administer all Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Leave of Absence (LOA) cases in partnership with the Company's leave administrator.
  • Manage compliance with federal, state, and local employment regulations.
  • Serve as the administrator for JJ Keller compliance programs.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and recordkeeping for employee leaves and compliance activities.

Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment activities, including background checks, drug screenings, and onboarding documentation.
  • Manage the onboarding process for new hires from offer acceptance through orientation.
  • Facilitate New Hire Orientation and ensure a positive onboarding experience.
  • Coordinate interview scheduling and candidate logistics as needed.
  • Support executive recruiting activities and candidate experience.

Internal Communications

  • Develop and distribute HR communications, announcements, newsletters, and employee updates.
  • Manage HR-related content on Cinch Connect, digital signage, and other communication platforms.
  • Assist with executive presentations and company-wide communications.
  • Maintain the HR communications calendar.

Employee Engagement

  • Serve as a member of and provide operational support for the Events Committee.
  • Coordinate employee recognition programs, engagement initiatives, wellness activities, and company events.
  • Support Town Halls, employee appreciation events, contests, and volunteer initiatives.

HR Business Partner Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the HR Business Partner team.
  • Prepare documentation related to employee relations matters, performance management, corrective actions, and organizational changes.
  • Assist with HR projects, talent initiatives, organizational planning, and reporting.
  • Support leaders and employees with HR policies, procedures, and self-service resources.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, or related field preferred.
  • 2-5 years of Human Resources, HR Operations, Employee Experience, or Communications experience.
  • Experience administering FMLA/LOA programs.
  • Experience supporting employee onboarding and HR compliance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with HRIS systems (UKG preferred).
  • Experience with Canva, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Microsoft Office.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment.

Preferred Qualifications

· Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered tools to improve productivity, streamline administrative processes, create communications, develop presentations, analyze data, and enhance the employee experience.

· Experience using AI applications (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Canva AI, Grammarly, or similar tools) to support HR operations, internal communications, and project management is preferred.

· Curiosity and willingness to evaluate and adopt emerging HR technologies and AI solutions that improve efficiency and service delivery.

title: Engineer - Systems Assurance
description:
We're looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Engineer - Systems Assurance to join our team in Fujairah, United Arab Emirates. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, and compliance of our critical systems through comprehensive testing, validation, and quality assurance processes. You will work collaboratively with engineering and operations teams to identify risks, implement solutions, and maintain the highest standards of system integrity.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure civil works for rail infrastructure comply with systems assurance principles, including safety, reliability, availability, and maintainability (RAMS) throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Implement and manage assurance processes in line with railway standards.

  • Develop and maintain the Systems Assurance Plan covering design, construction, testing, and commissioning phases.

  • Ensure full requirements traceability from employer requirements through design, construction, and final handover.

  • Review civil design submissions to ensure compliance with safety-in-design and operational safety requirements for rail systems.

  • Coordinate closely with track, signaling, MEP, utilities, and systems teams to manage civil interface requirements.

  • Conduct and support hazard identification (HAZID), risk assessments, and safety analysis for civil railway assets (stations, viaducts, tunnels, trackworks).

  • Ensure implementation of Verification & Validation (V&V) processes for all civil deliverables and construction activities.

  • Monitor compliance with railway authority standards.

  • Review Method Statements, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), and assurance deliverables for compliance with system safety requirements.

  • Participate in design and construction safety audits, assurance audits, and site surveillance activities.

  • Track and close out safety-related non-conformances, audit findings, and assurance observations.

  • Ensure proper management of design changes through configuration control and impact assessment on safety and performance.

  • Support integration of civil works with railway systems during testing, integration, and commissioning stages.

  • Verify that construction activities do not compromise operational safety, track geometry stability, or long-term durability.

  • Ensure implementation of risk mitigation measures identified during safety and assurance studies.

  • Support incident investigation and root cause analysis for civil-related safety or quality issues.

  • Maintain assurance registers including risk logs, compliance matrices, and traceability records.

  • Assist in preparation of safety cases, assurance evidence, and certification dossiers for handover to the client.

  • Coordinate with contractors, consultants, and client representatives to ensure assurance requirements are clearly understood and implemented on site.

  • Contribute to final system acceptance, operational readiness reviews, and handover of civil railway assets.

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in systems assurance, quality engineering, or related technical field
  • Expereince working on freight facilities

title: Counsel, Global Supply Chain, Trade, and Human Rights
description:
Working with Us
Challenging. Meaningful. Life-changing. Those aren’t words that are usually associated with a job. But working at Bristol Myers Squibb is anything but usual. Here, uniquely interesting work happens every day, in every department. From optimizing a production line to the latest breakthroughs in cell therapy, this is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. You’ll get the chance to grow and thrive through opportunities uncommon in scale and scope, alongside high-achieving teams. Take your career farther than you thought possible.

Bristol Myers Squibb recognizes the importance of balance and flexibility in our work environment. We offer a wide variety of competitive benefits, services and programs that provide our employees with the resources to pursue their goals, both at work and in their personal lives. Read more: .

Position Summary

The Counsel, Supply Chain, Trade, and Human Rights serves as a legal advisor to the Global Supply Chain (GSC) organization, including its Customs & Trade function. This attorney provides strategic, regulatory, and transactional counsel across the clinical and commercial supply networks that deliver BMS medicines to patients around the world.

This is a high-visibility role focused on issues including tariffs, trade policy, sanctions, import/export controls, supply continuity, and human rights due diligence. This attorney will collaborate closely with others in Law & Policy and the business.

The role sits within the Product Development & Supply (PDS) Law team, a collaborative and dynamic group within the Global Drug Development, Manufacturing & Corporate Transactions (GDMCT) legal team at BMS. The PDS Law team provides comprehensive legal support for internal and external manufacturing operations, supply chain, customs and trade, engineering, real estate, and EOHSS. The broader GDMCT legal team also supports Drug Development, Product Development, Global Quality, and transactional support across the enterprise.

This attorney will work alongside colleagues with deep subject matter expertise across manufacturing, quality, regulatory, and transactional practices, on work that is directly connected to the delivery of medicines to patients.

The successful candidate brings excellent legal judgment, learns quickly, navigates complexity, and works with urgency and creativity across regulatory schemes and stakeholders, always prioritizing the urgent needs of patients. The ability to build programs and communicate clearly on complex topics with senior business stakeholders is critical to success in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a legal advisor to the Global Supply Chain organization, advising on complex issues that arise in the supply of product across the clinical and commercial networks to enable the urgent delivery of medicines to patients.

  • Serve as a legal advisor on global trade matters, including tariffs and trade remedies, customs and import/export compliance, economic sanctions, export controls, and trade-related licensing, working closely with Customs & Trade leads to develop practical mitigation and compliance strategies.

  • Serve as a legal advisor on human rights matters, including due diligence related to forced labor, responsible sourcing, supply chain transparency, and emerging human rights laws and standards, partnering with business and compliance stakeholders to assess risk and develop practical mitigation strategies.

  • Monitor evolving global trade and supply chain regulations and enforcement trends, and proactively advise senior leadership on business impact, risk mitigation, and opportunities.

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex supply, logistics, transportation, and warehousing agreements.

  • Advise on supply disruption, business continuity, and crisis response matters affecting the global network.

  • Collaborate across the Law & Policy Department, including regulatory, ESG, policy, litigation, and IP colleagues, to deliver coordinated, enterprise-aligned legal support to GSC.

A Patient Service Representative (PSR) is often a patient’s first impression of Advocate Health and frequently is the starting point and foundation for all Revenue Cycle functions. The PSR helps prevent the loss of revenue and impacts operating margins through the accuracy and timeliness of their workflows. The PSR ensures mandated regulations are followed and patient satisfaction is optimized. The PSR plays a crucial role in connecting a variety of departments for the overall success of the patient’s experience and the organization’s financial success. Often works without direct supervision present.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Creates the initial electronic health record that serves as the foundation of the patient medical record that is utilized by all members of the healthcare team. Prevents creation of duplicate medical records that can cause treatment safety issues and billing problems. Follows and ensures compliance with the mandate of the organization’s accrediting bodies to use identifiers to positively identify a patient prior to the delivery of patient care to ensure patient safety.

  • Checks in and registers patients; obtains and verifies complete demographic, guarantor, and insurance information; discusses and collects co-pays and other out-of-pocket patient responsibilities. Obtaining accurate information at the point of registration helps ensure timely payment to the organization and prevents billing issues and patient complaints. Maintains complete confidentiality regarding patient personal/financial information and medical records in accordance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

Understands and discusses financial information and obligations with patients. Knows how and when to refer patients to Financial Advocates.

Examples are HIPAA, Emergency Medical Treatment and Active Labor Act (EMTALA), Consent for Treatment, Patient Rights and Responsibilities, Important Message from Medicare (IMM), Medicare Outpatient Observation Notice (MOON), Notice of Privacy Practices, Medicare Secondary Payer Questionnaire (MSPQ), Advanced Beneficiary Notice (ABN). Obtains patient or guarantor signatures as required.
